</nowiki><div><u><nowiki>Mandatory AFK Requirements</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>The following are required or this method will not work:

⬥ Fast Instance Speed (</nowiki><u><nowiki>not</nowiki></u><nowiki> Fastest)
⬥ Necklace of Salamancy </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/970657245312467004.png?v=1" alt="necklaceofsalamancy" title="necklaceofsalamancy" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
⬥ Elder Overload Salve </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/648976643687317532.png?v=1" alt="elderovlsalve" title="elderovlsalve" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
⬥ Dinosaur Slayer Task </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1" alt="slayer" title="slayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
⬥ Powder of Penance </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/928221126360969226.png?v=1" alt="powderofpenance" title="powderofpenance" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
⬥ Greater Ricochet </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1" alt="grico" title="grico" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
⬥ Igneous Kal-Xil </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/902209626404171786.png?v=1" alt="igneouskalxil" title="igneouskalxil" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or Igneous Kal-Zuk </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/902209626479685734.png?v=1" alt="igneouskalzuk" title="igneouskalzuk" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
⬥ Elite Dracolich Armour </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1179717430436704306.png?v=1" alt="edracobody" title="edracobody" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
⬥ Active God Scripture </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1266417822188437569.png?v=1" alt="scriptureofamascut" title="scriptureofamascut" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
⬥ Ful Arrows </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/971025696958853180.png?v=1" alt="fularrow" title="fularrow" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
⬥ Persistent Rage </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/739965637056659567.png?v=1" alt="persistentrage" title="persistentrage" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
⬥ Ultimatums 4 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478090603026710648.png?v=1" alt="ultimatums4" title="ultimatums4" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
⬥ Desolation </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159018098713.png?v=1" alt="desolation" title="desolation" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
⬥ Insulated Boots </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841409588876279819.png?v=1" alt="insulatedboots" title="insulatedboots" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
⬥ Holy Scarab Familiar to upkeep prayer </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/929773040273862656.png?v=1" alt="holyscarab" title="holyscarab" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
⬥ Enhanced Excalibur and Vampyrism for sustain </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641337999170207763.png?v=1" alt="excal" title="excal" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1494069423047442573.png?v=1" alt="vampyrismaspect" title="vampyrismaspect" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
⬥ BoLG with Shard of Genesis Essence </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994189289623662702.png?v=1" alt="bolg" title="bolg" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1266418218264694954.png?v=1" alt="shardofgenesisessence" title="shardofgenesisessence" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
⬥ Auto-retaliate is on
